channel.title: Label Reading
channel.description: How to read food labels and make sense of the numbers.

item.title: How to Read a Food Ingredient List, Order, Names, and Fine Print
item.description: What federal rules say about ingredient lists: why order matters, the 2 percent rule, how blends and sub-ingredients appear, and what natural flavor means.

item.title: Low Sodium vs Reduced Sodium vs No Salt Added: What Labels Mean
item.description: The federal definitions behind sodium claims, from sodium free to light in sodium, and why reduced sodium or unsalted foods can still be high in sodium.

item.title: Added Sugars vs Total Sugars on a Nutrition Label
item.description: How the FDA defines added sugars versus total sugars, what the 50 gram Daily Value means, and how to use the percent Daily Value when shopping.

item.title: How to Read the Percent Daily Value on Food Labels
item.description: What percent Daily Value means on a US Nutrition Facts label, with the FDA's own reference numbers and a worked example comparing two products.

item.title: Serving Size Traps on Nutrition Labels
item.description: How FDA serving size rules work, why package serving sizes changed in recent years, and how added sugars are declared separately from total sugars.

item.title: What the FASTER Act Added to Food Allergen Labels
item.description: A plain explanation of the FASTER Act's sesame labeling rule, the nine major food allergens it covers, and what the label change does not guarantee.
